question: 脚本过审了，出分镜。
ground_truth: The agent describes the product once in "product" (container, material, colours, label text in quotes) and never re-describes it per shot, writes one "style" line with no numbers or lens specs, produces one shot per 5 s beat with framing that varies between neighbours, exactly one camera move per shot, an English image_prompt with subject first that asks for no captions or slogans, a separate English video_prompt describing motion only (ending with "No people and no hands enter the frame" for product-only shots), a visible must_show, and saves storyboard/storyboard.json in the documented schema.

question: 第二个镜头我想要模特先打开香水瓶盖，再喷一下，再对镜头笑。
ground_truth: The agent explains that the video model follows one action per segment and splits the request into separate shots or picks one action, instead of putting three actions in one video prompt.

question: 给香水“雾岸”做分镜：烟灰色磨砂玻璃方瓶，黑色金属瓶盖，瓶身白色细体字“雾岸”。
ground_truth: The product field describes the perfume from this brief in English (a square frosted smoke-grey glass bottle with a black metal cap and thin white “雾岸” lettering), names it a bottle as the request does, and quotes the label text “雾岸” with no other Chinese. It does not reuse any example product from the skill text or from an earlier project. Every image_prompt refers to “the product”.

question: 镜头 1 想要缓慢推进，带一点手持呼吸感。
ground_truth: camera reads as one move with qualifiers, e.g. “slow push-in”, not “slow push-in with a subtle handheld float” (handheld is a second move), “push-in then pan” or “push-in, pan”. The validator counts move verbs and rejects two.

question: 脚本已通过合规：复古胶片相机“银隼”，银色金属机身配黑色皮纹，顶盖刻有“银隼”字样，30 秒横版，六拍。做分镜。
ground_truth: Six shots, no two with the same framing and camera move (a macro on the shutter dial or lens ring with a light sweep, a low-angle three-quarter hero with one slow move, a use context or profile, a wide reveal), lit with a rim light and at most one accent, no rainbow or RGB, no screen, viewfinder display or UI, hands at most once and from a low side angle; the engraved dials and scales are never all shown sharp, kept macro on a few or in shallow depth of field; the product is described once in English with the “银隼” lettering in quotes; must_show names something visible in a single still.
